# VARUNA

> AI-powered digital twin for Bihar's climate risk monitoring, prediction, and decision support.

VARUNA is a climate intelligence dashboard built for Bihar, India. It combines real-time and historical climate data with machine-learning forecasts and what-if simulation tools to help disaster-management, agriculture, health, and infrastructure teams anticipate floods, heatwaves, drought, and compound risks.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Executive overview of current climate risk, key indicators, and AI-generated recommendations for Bihar.
- [Bihar Risk Map](/map): Interactive block-level map with layered flood, heat, drought, and compound risk visualisations, plus search and export tools.
- [Compound Risk](/compound): Multi-hazard analysis showing how overlapping climate stressors combine across districts and blocks over time.
- [Prediction Engine](/prediction): PI-GNN-powered forecasts for rainfall, temperature, and risk indices with validation metrics and confidence bands.
- [What-If Simulator](/simulator): Scenario-planning tool to test rainfall, temperature, and humidity anomalies and compare projected impacts.
- [Alerts](/alerts): Live climate risk alerts, notification settings, threshold configuration, and alert history.
- [Decision Reports](/reports): Generate, preview, and download situation reports and decision briefs for NDRF, agriculture, health, and infrastructure stakeholders.

## Guides

- [Kosi Basin Hydrology](/guides/kosi-basin-hydrology): Block-level guide to Kosi River flood risk in Bihar, explaining why the basin accounts for 76% of the state's flood impact and how AI-based block-level forecasting provides earlier warnings than district-level alerts.

## Optional

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing the VARUNA digital twin and its core capabilities.
